cases.scenario: User supplies a desktop screenshot and asks to extract typography, palette, spacing, and layout specs.
must_pass: Remains strictly read-only (zero code generated or modified)
Uses 14-point extraction schema
Marks inferred values and unobservable motion explicitly

cases.scenario: User supplies an authorized landing page screenshot and asks to build it in React + Tailwind.
must_pass: Implements smallest complete code matching stack
Renders and compares against reference or discloses missing browser evidence
Reports unavailable assets and unavoidable differences honestly without false pixel-perfect claims

cases.scenario: User asks for visual inspiration for an editorial architecture studio site.
must_pass: Remains strictly read-only (does not start coding)
Provides real-world verified links with technique explanations
Uses descriptive/link fallback if inline images are unsupported

cases.scenario: User wants creative directions for a developer observability SaaS before planning.
must_pass: Remains strictly read-only
Produces 2-4 genuinely distinct directions (not color-only swaps) with 10-part cards
Allows selection/combination into /formforge-plan

cases.scenario: User asks to extract Design DNA from an existing Next.js + Tailwind repo and check a new page for drift.
must_pass: Treats code/tokens as authoritative without duplicating token tables
Maintains lightweight DESIGN.md without secrets or PII
Flags off-scale spacing or unapproved pattern drift

cases.scenario: User asks for a shared-element drawer transition and draggable card list.
must_pass: Specifies full 12-point Animation Specification Contract
Prefers native CSS/WAAPI/View Transitions first
Includes interruptibility, keyboard parity, and prefers-reduced-motion alternative

cases.scenario: User asks to verify a built checkout page against the locked /formforge-plan master prompt.
must_pass: Audits 10 contract dimensions rather than generic technical checks alone
Classifies deviations by severity without introducing subjective redesigns
Applies fixes only when authorized

cases.scenario: User runs /formforge-help to see all available commands.
must_pass: Displays all 25 commands, workflows, examples, and read-only notes directly
Loads zero unrelated references/*.md modules
